content_sections.heading: About VIT
content_sections.text: Vidyalankar Institute of Technology is located at Vidyalankar College Marg, Wadala East, Mumbai. The notice describes it as approved by AICTE and DTE Maharashtra State and affiliated to University of Mumbai. The notice presents the posts under the heading "Faculty Opportunities: Teaching | Research | Innovation".

content_sections.heading: Departments and Areas of Specialisation
content_sections.text: The notice lists six departments. It does not give vacancy numbers or post-wise or category-wise break-ups. Information Technology Computer Engineering Electronics and Computer Science Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering Biomedical Engineering Management Studies VIT is looking for candidates who are specialised and/or working in the following areas, "but not limited to" them: Agentic AI Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Business Analytics, Digital Marketing and AI Cloud Computing Cloud Engineering Communication Skills Data Mining and Warehousing Data Science Design Thinking DevOps Entrepreneurship General Management Healthcare Technology Indian Knowledge System Internet of Everything Sustainable Business VLSI Web and App Development Wireless Networks
